newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch store drops "Nazi" coat after complaints.
newsitem.headline: Dutch store drops "Nazi" coat after complaints.

text.p: Dutch department store De Bijenkorf has removed a woman's coat from its new fashion line after complaints that it resembled a Nazi uniform, De Telegraaf newspaper said on Thursday.

The print on the coat was an almost exact match with the pattern of the camouflage battledress worn by the Waffen-SS, which was responsible for many atrocities during the Second World War, the paper said.
The 149 guilder ($90) coat was removed from the racks last night by Bijenkorf management. It appeared in a catalogue widely distributed in the Netherlands on Wednesday.
The store will be asking its buyers for an explanation of the incident, the paper said. Bijenkorf was not immediately available for comment.
